headline: BrasilAgro Cuts Corn Area as Margins Drop to 2%, Reports R$81M Profit
summary: Agribusiness firm BrasilAgro reduced corn planting after profit margins fell to 2%, while reporting a Q1 net profit of R$81 million despite cereal sales tripling.
why: BrasilAgro is a prominent Latin American farmland acquisition and agricultural operation company, managing large-scale grain and bioenergy crop production.
